messages:
ben: Heads-up — opening a PR to split `modules/network` into `network/vpc` + `network/peering`. Need quick eyes on provider pin strategy and secrets wiring. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342
anya: Can you paste the changed provider blocks? want to confirm we don't accidentally hoist a root provider again.
ben: snippet from the new module: ```hcl
provider \"aws\" { region = var.region }
module \"vpc\" {
  source = \"./network/vpc\"
  providers = { aws = aws }
  vars = { cidr = var.vpc_cidr }
}
```
mike: If you keep `providers = { aws = aws }` we avoid hoisting. downside: lockfile will include instances for each module path. For compatibility I'd rather pin `hashicorp/aws` in the lockfile to a stable patch: e.g. `== 4.60.0` for the rollout window.
anya: Agreed on temporary exact pin for the rotation window. After the split we should run `terraform init -upgrade` and then `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` to regenerate. Also add a short note in the module README about provider expectations.
sara: One more on secrets — new modules need `var.secret_path`. Current consumers read `data.terraform_remote_state.secrets.outputs.k8s_secret_path`. Suggest default = "${data.terraform_remote_state.secrets.outputs.k8s_secret_path}" and document that Dedicated/onprem teams must set it explicitly.
ben: Good call. I'll add `variable \"secret_path\" { type = string }` and wire it in. Planning to run a staged plan against staging and then prod. infra-bot: build/plan job started for branch=feature/module-split (staging): https://ci.redwood.com/job/plan/987 status=queued
anya: Quick FYI: if we pin providers exactly, ops will need to approve backports for security fixes. Maybe add `providers.md` with guidance: short-term exact pin + scheduled bump PRs every 2 weeks.
mike: Also check the lockfile checksum in CI — we've seen flakes when multiple devs run different `terraform` versions. Recommend adding `tfenv` pin in repo and CI use `hashicorp/terraform:1.5.9` image for lockfile ops.
ben: Will update CI Dockerfile and add `providers.md`. Tagging @mike @anya for review — merging after a clean plan. :thumbsup:
